name: Gale Crater
description: Gale Crater — MSL Curiosity landing site. 154-km diameter impact crater containing Aeolis Mons (Mount Sharp), a ~5 km high layered sedimentary mound. Terrain elevation from MOLA MEGDR (128 px/degree, ~463 m/pixel). Crater floor elevation approximately -4500 m; rim approximately -1000 to 0 m; central mound rises to approximately -4000 m (approximately +500 m above crater floor). Real MOLA elevation data extracted from PDS tile MEGT00N090HB.
